cat > rosterkit/notices.py <<'EOF'
"""Plain-text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


# ---
def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    """Build a short notice listing the days a student was absent."""
    marks = list(marks)
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"mark for {mark.student_id} given for "
                f"{student.student_id}"
            )
    days = days_missed(marks)
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError(f"no absences for {student.student_id}")
    unit = "day" if len(days) == 1 else "days"
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    return (
        f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed "
        f"{len(days)} {unit}: {dates}."
    )
# end of file
EOF
cat > tests/test_notices.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from rosterkit.attendance import parse_day
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice

STUDENT = Student("s1", "Lee", "Ana", "A")


def make_mark(student_id, text, status):
    return Mark(student_id, parse_day(text), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_dates_in_order(self):
        """Absent days are counted and listed oldest first."""
        marks = [
            make_mark("s1", "2026-09-04", "absent"),
            make_mark("s1", "2026-09-03", "absent"),
            make_mark("s1", "2026-09-05", "present")
        ]
        text = absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertTrue("Ana Lee missed 2 days" in text)
        self.assertTrue(
            text.endswith("2026-09-03, 2026-09-04.")
        )

    def test_other_student_raises(self):
        """A mark for another student is rejected."""
        marks = [make_mark("s2", "2026-09-03", "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_raises(self):
        """Having no absent days is an error."""
        marks = [make_mark("s1", "2026-09-03", "excused")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
# end of file
EOF
